review: Backend integration needs a practical HTTP contract, async resource ownership, and provider-independent errors that ordinary application code can use.
build: Implement task creation, task status, and cancellation endpoints around a fake agent adapter. Validate input and persist owner, operation key, and terminal outcome. Model bounded asyncio workers, a commit followed by lost HTTP acknowledgment, changed-payload retry and cancellation; explain why this is not distributed exactly-once execution.
verify: A retry with the same payload reuses its task, a reused key with different input is rejected, and resource cleanup occurs after timeout or cancellation. Run `python3 -B labs/async_backend_failure.py` and verify PASS. Check max worker concurrency, unique effect counts, cross-owner operation IDs and cancellation cleanup; document production database limitations.
